name: Voodoo Charm
summary: In Teldrassil’s barrows, the Voodoo Charm can break the Gnarlpine enchantment holding Oben Rageclaw’s body.

sections.title: A Severing of Dark Bonds
sections.body: The spirit of Oben Rageclaw is separated from his flesh in the Gnarlpine barrow dens of Teldrassil. The furbolgs used foul magic to control the sleeping forms of sacred kaldorei protectors, and Oben’s body remains under their sorcery. He examines the charm and sees that its dark tether cannot be dispelled through traditional prayers. Once his soulless body is struck down, the charm must be channeled over the fallen form to purge the furbolg hold. Then Oben’s wandering spirit can depart for the Emerald Dream forever.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Voodoo Charm?
faq.answer: The Voodoo Charm breaks the Gnarlpine furbolgs’ magical control over Oben Rageclaw. After his soulless, enthralled body is struck down, the charm must be used on his remains to sever the enchantment and free his soul.

faq.q: Who gives you the Voodoo Charm?
aliases: where do i get voodoo charm
faq.answer: The spirit of Oben Rageclaw gives you the Voodoo Charm during Druid of the Claw. After examining it, he explains how it can free him from the Gnarlpine tribe’s sorcery.

faq.q: Why is it called a Voodoo Charm in night elf lands?
faq.answer: The name reflects the foreign or distorted occult magic of the Gnarlpine furbolgs, who have succumbed to corruption and bizarre tribal magic as it seeped into the Great Tree. The charm represents the magic used to ensnare and puppeteer the bodies of resting druids.

faq.q: What happens after the charm is used?
faq.answer: Once the charm breaks the enchantment on Oben Rageclaw’s body, he is freed from the Gnarlpine tribe’s grip. His physical vessel is laid to rest, and his spirit departs Teldrassil for the Emerald Dream.

angles.text: For young druids training in Teldrassil, using the charm to mercy-kill and release a brother Druid of the Claw shows the tragic vulnerability of leaving one’s physical shell behind while traveling through the Emerald Dream.
For night elves, the charm reveals how deeply the Gnarlpine furbolgs have degenerated, turning sacred kaldorei barrow dens into places of grotesque spiritual imprisonment.
